newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Oct 21.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Oct 21 include:
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
* Baan forecast is in millions of US dollar.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, Gilissen Bankiers, ING, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Lanschot Bankiers, Rabo/IRIS and Strating.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting Oct 28 we are collecting Q3 result forecasts for DSM, Koninklijke Shell, KNP BT and ATAG.
